title: Elasticity and agility

kcs.statement: Elasticity is automatically adding and removing resources as demand changes, so a workload pays only for the capacity it needs at that moment.
Scalability is the ability to handle more load by adding resources; elasticity adds automation in both directions, scaling out when demand rises and back in when it falls.
In AWS terms, agility is how fast new IT resources become available (minutes instead of weeks), which lowers the cost and time of experimenting and innovating.

problem_ideas: A ticket site's traffic jumps 10x for 2 hours then drops: which benefit lets it avoid paying for peak all day?
A data team spins up a 50-node test cluster in 5 minutes and deletes it after lunch: elasticity or agility?
Classify six statements as scalability, elasticity or agility.
A retailer adds servers by hand each December and never removes them: what is missing for elasticity?
Rewrite a wrong exam option, 'Agility means the system resizes itself automatically', so it is correct.
Estimate the idle server-hours saved when 40 servers are needed 4 hours a day but 10 servers the rest of the time.
